content.title: About Me
content: I am a frontend developer who enjoys combining clean, structured code with user-friendly design. My main tools include modern web technologies such as React and TypeScript, but I also enjoy working with processes, data, and communication across teams.

My path started in high school with small experiments in HTML and CSS and grew through my studies in computer science. Along the way, I worked on projects such as RehaCat+ and my bachelor thesis, where I learned how much I value clarity, teamwork, and sustainable solutions.
What drives me most are projects where code quality and user experience go hand in hand, and where technology becomes understandable and usable for others.
content.footer: My very first website from high school never went online, but it sparked the passion that drives me today.
